'''Ramna''' was a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She trained newer members of CorSec as pilots. Ramna also often visited [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].
